verdict.rationale: Docs mention CLI/API management of 'batches' of calls (bolna-docs-16, bolna-docs-24) and a throughput claim of 'thousands of inbound and outbound calls every minute' (bolna-docs-22), supporting batch outbound campaigns with scale. However, there is no documented scheduling feature (e.g., campaign start times, recurring runs) or explicit throughput-control settings (rate limiting, concurrency caps) beyond the marketing claim. missing for 10: explicit scheduling API/UI for campaigns, documented throughput/concurrency control settings, independent corroboration of batch campaign performance.
